verdict.rationale: Netlify's own homepage includes a first-party example to "Resize an image to 800px wide", which points to a built-in image transformation capability. The evidence is a single thin mention with no documentation of a CDN, on-demand URL-based transforms, or format and quality optimization. The visual-media item in the integrations directory is a third-party integration, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented built-in image CDN, on-demand transform parameters, format/compression optimization details, caching behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN
